"""Meta scope probe: same prompt/flags as run-c2.py, but settings with allow Bash and NO deny rules."""
import importlib.util, json, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
root = Path(sys.argv[1]); out = Path(sys.argv[2])
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("runc2", root / "evidence/frontier-challenges/c2-claude-deny-vs-git-guardrails/runner/run-c2.py")
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
fx = json.loads((root / "evidence/frontier-challenges/c2-claude-deny-vs-git-guardrails/fixture/commands.json").read_text())
ids = ["D01", "D10", "D12", "S06"]
res = {}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="gaia-c2p-") as td:
    s = Path(td) / "settings.json"; s.write_text(json.dumps({"permissions": {"allow": ["Bash"], "deny": []}}))
    for c in fx["commands"]:
        if c["id"] in ids:
            o, d = m.run_native(c, s)
            res[c["id"]] = {"command": c["command"], "attempted": o["attempted"], "effectObserved": o["effectObserved"],
                            "class": m.classify(c["kind"], o["attempted"], o["effectObserved"]),
                            "toolResultHead": [r["text"][:90] for r in d["toolResults"]], "model": d["model"]}
out.write_text(json.dumps({"probe": "c2 native with deny=[] (allow Bash only)", "settings": {"permissions": {"allow": ["Bash"], "deny": []}}, "results": res}, indent=1, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
print(json.dumps(res, indent=1))
